tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Brand ground: hero, page bands, section backgrounds, slides. The colour people know PBJ by. Never as text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Ground for long reading and platform screens (wallet, price board, shop) where a full sky ground would tire the eye.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on sky or surface: cards, nav bar, inputs, dialogs. Also the fill of the cloud motif.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows and inside cards. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons; at least 3:1 on cloud and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on sky, surface and cloud.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on sky, surface and cloud.

tokens.name: jelly
tokens.usage: The accent. Primary buttons, drips, badges, display highlights, the active state. As text only at 24px+ or 19px bold, on cloud or surface; on sky it is a fill, never text.

tokens.name: on-jelly
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a jelly fill. In light, keep labels 19px bold or larger (white on jelly is 4.4:1).

tokens.name: jelly-text
tokens.usage: Red text below 24px: eyebrows, inline links on cloud and surface, price drops, error messages.

tokens.name: jelly-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind jelly-text: badges, error fields, the loss chip.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Peanut butter. Marks the Peanut currency only: the Peanut glyph, wallet bars, balance highlights. Never a general accent.

tokens.name: butter-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind Peanut amounts and the wallet card.

tokens.name: butter-text
tokens.usage: Peanut amounts as text, on butter-soft, cloud and surface.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Share price up and positive returns, always with a ▲ and a + sign. Blue, not green, so it never relies on red/green alone. On cloud and surface.

tokens.name: gain-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind gain text in chips.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Emphasis cards and the footer: the one card in a row that is PBJ's own answer.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels and links on inverse.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid with 3px offset so the ground shows between ring and control.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page. 56px below 640px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers on landing pages. 40px below 640px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page and section headings inside the app and on content pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, timeline day names.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat tiles, countdown digits, wallet balance. Set tabular-nums.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Students pitch, fund, build and prove that people want it.
styles.usage: Hero subline and section intros, max 60 characters wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Teams invest 20,000–40,000 Peanuts in other teams after the pitches.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Peanuts can never be cashed out.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. 19px bold keeps white on jelly at large-text contrast.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and tags. Always write the text in capitals; colour it jelly-text or ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside badges and between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field label to input; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on phones; gaps in dense UI.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons' inner elements, list rows, shop items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the wallet card. The deck's card radius.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, chips, the nav bar.

tokens.name: shadow-cloud
tokens.usage: Cards and the nav bar floating on sky.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Dialogs and anything above the page.
